summary: ERROR TO THE DISTRICT COURT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE MIDDLE DISTRICT OF ALABAMA.
attorneys: Mr. R. T. Merrick for plaintiff in error., Mr. Samuel F. Rice for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Hunt
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Hunt

delivered the opinion of the court.

The case of The County of Lee, plaintiff in error, v. Clews, defendant, (No. 79,) involves the same questions and is decided by the same principles as Chambers County v. Clews, 21 Wall. 317.

The judgment is Affirmed.
